decisions.reason: As a flagship product close to the firm's existing practice management and regulatory knowledge, it builds directly on established expertise, enabling the firm to assimilate feedback and improve it, so withdrawal is unlikely.

The analytics dashboard leverages the firm's existing practice data and software engineering capabilities, giving it sufficient absorptive capacity to interpret early results and enhance the product, so withdrawal risk is low.
As a complete bundle composed of modules close to the firm's core offer, it draws on established knowledge and customer relationships, allowing the firm to support and improve it effectively.

This job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm's core software and regulatory workflow knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve the product, so withdrawal is likely.
